prompt: Your team runs a self-hosted nginx edge with proxy_cache in front of the origin for a video-delivery pipeline — it caches HLS playlist manifests, video segments, and poster/thumbnail assets, and ran with a high HIT ratio for months. After the latest deploy, two things shipped together: share/campaign links now carry utm_* marketing query params, and the backend team added a session middleware — and the HIT ratio collapsed while origin load spiked. Ops attached X-Cache-Status to responses and sees mostly MISS on requests for identical content. Here's the edge cache config and the new origin middleware: walk me through exactly why equivalent requests stopped collapsing to one cache entry, and how you'd fix the cache key and Vary behavior to restore the HIT ratio.
